decisions.reason: The compact rotating dumper still has its own page and fits the firm's announced construction-machinery line, and the investment already made favors persisting with it.
The articulated construction dumper remains prominently presented and central to the firm's construction portfolio, so management stays committed to it.

The rescue vehicle was downgraded from its own page to a mention, a sign of weaker commitment, but it belongs to the core mining strategy and modest results can be blamed on long, lumpy mining procurement cycles.
The compact telescopic loader keeps a dedicated page and extends the compact construction range the firm has publicly invested in.
The Easy 18 material lift is touted as the long-standing favorite in the rental market and has just won a large order, so there is no reason to drop it.
The compact mining loader has a dedicated page and publicly reported results of 1,000 operating hours in 7 months, which strongly reinforces commitment to it.
